back.en: Distance in a specified direction. Vector. Unit: m
back.bm: Jarak dalam arah tertentu. Vektor. Unit: m

back.en: Rate of change of displacement. Unit: m s⁻¹
back.bm: Kadar perubahan sesaran. Unit: m s⁻¹

back.en: Rate of change of velocity. Unit: m s⁻²
back.bm: Kadar perubahan halaju. Unit: m s⁻²

back.en: Motion under gravity only. Acceleration g ≈ 9.81 m s⁻², same for all masses
back.bm: Gerakan di bawah graviti sahaja. Pecutan g ≈ 9.81 m s⁻², sama untuk semua jisim

back.en: Tendency to stay at rest or keep moving uniformly in a straight line. Bigger mass → bigger inertia
back.bm: Kecenderungan untuk kekal pegun atau terus bergerak seragam dalam garis lurus. Jisim besar → inersia besar

back.en: Total momentum before = total momentum after, if no external force acts
back.bm: Jumlah momentum sebelum = jumlah momentum selepas, jika tiada daya luar bertindak

back.en: Elastic: objects separate, kinetic energy conserved. Inelastic: objects stick together. Momentum conserved in both
back.bm: Kenyal: objek berpisah, tenaga kinetik diabadikan. Tidak kenyal: objek bergerak bersama. Momentum diabadikan dalam kedua-duanya

back.en: Rate of change of momentum is proportional to the force: F = ma
back.bm: Kadar perubahan momentum berkadar terus dengan daya: F = ma

back.en: Change in momentum: Ft = mv − mu. Unit: N s
back.bm: Perubahan momentum: Ft = mv − mu. Unit: N s

back.en: Increase the impact time (airbags, crumple zones, bending knees on landing)
back.bm: Panjangkan masa hentaman (beg udara, zon remuk, bengkokkan lutut semasa mendarat)

back.en: Weight = gravitational force, W = mg (N). Mass = amount of matter (kg), same everywhere
back.bm: Berat = daya graviti, W = mg (N). Jisim = kuantiti jirim (kg), sama di mana-mana

back.en: From rest: u = 0. Comes to a stop: v = 0
